description:
v13 province adjacency (same method as v12) (movement graph) + road/terrain game attributes.
Border test (as v11): shared edge of the "gap Voronoi" (every map px within GAP_REACH of a province goes to the nearest
province, 4 map px raster); neighbours when that edge is >= MIN_SHARED map px. Corner/point contacts are dropped.
link types: land (land-land border), sea (sea-sea border), coastal (sea<->land: sea->land 'landing', land->sea 'embark'),
strait (island <-> nearby mainland across short water, no sea tile needed).
v13: same rules as v12. Rotsla (96) has NO strait links (reachable by sea only); manual land link 5<->9; straits 3-2, 3-5, 72-75 kept;
coastal links recomputed with the new west-coast sea corridor (S41-S52).
road_link: true when a main or secondary road actually crosses the shared border (road line passes from one province's
gap-Voronoi cell straight into the other's). rail_link likewise for railways.

link_types.coastal: sea<->land along the coast; on a land province = embark (land->sea / port), on a sea province = landing (sea->land)
link_types.strait: island <-> nearby mainland across short water without a sea tile

edge_fields.road_link: true when a main or secondary road crosses this border (movement road bonus)
edge_fields.road_link_class: best road crossing the border: main|secondary|minor|none
edge_fields.rail_link: true when a railway crosses this border
edge_fields.shared_border: length of the shared border (map px)
edge_fields.gap: drawn gap between the two shapes (map px)

edges.note: owner request (kept from v12): Tirsa Northwest <-> Nanta
across the narrow Zille Bay inlet (S52): Azzurra (Azzurra shore) <-> Rivamare (Rivamare shore), as v12 34<->38

manual_links: owner request (kept from v12): Tirsa Northwest <-> Nanta
across the narrow Zille Bay inlet (S52): Azzurra (Azzurra shore) <-> Rivamare (Rivamare shore), as v12 34<->38

rule.road_link: main or secondary road line crosses from one province cell into the other (sampled every 2 map px on the gap-Voronoi raster)
